sections.heading: C2 — Licensing basics and graduated licensing
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Licensing basics and graduated licensing

FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A16
For the first six months after license issuance, a driver younger than seventeen may carry no more than one passenger younger than seventeen unless the passengers are related to the driver through blood, adoption or marriage. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A16
A person aged seventeen or older may take driver training using a Class D instruction permit. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A16
A person aged seventeen or older may use a driver training permit or, after driver education, a supervised instruction permit for driver training. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A19
An applicant younger than seventeen who has never held an Idaho license must complete approved driver training and the GDL requirements. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A19
The graduated licensing path requires at least six months of supervised instruction without violations. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A19
The supervising driver during the GDL instruction period must have a valid license and be at least twenty-one. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A19
During GDL supervision, the supervising driver must sit in the front seat next to the learner. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A19
The GDL learner may not carry another passenger in the front seat during supervised instruction. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A19
A GDL learner must ensure that every occupant uses a seat belt or required child restraint. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A19
The supervised GDL period requires compliance with the laws on alcohol and other intoxicating substances. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A19
The GDL learner must log at least fifty hours of supervised driving. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A19
At least ten of the supervised GDL driving hours must occur at night. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R13 | anchor: A19
A conviction for a traffic violation committed while driving under the supervised instruction period cancels the permit and requires a new permit application. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R14 | anchor: A19
After a conviction for a traffic violation committed while driving under supervised instruction, a newly issued permit starts the minimum six-month supervised period again. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R15 | anchor: A19
Completion of the GDL requirements must be followed by passing the knowledge and skills tests before a license is issued. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R16 | anchor: A19
Approved Idaho driver training includes thirty hours of classroom teaching. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R17 | anchor: A19
Approved Idaho driver training includes six hours observing other students from inside the vehicle. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R18 | anchor: A19
Approved Idaho driver training includes six hours driving with an approved instructor. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R19 | anchor: A15
For the driver training permit described for applicants aged fourteen and a half to younger than seventeen, the handbook gives an expiration five days after the holder turns eighteen. [A15]
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec01-R20 | anchor: A03
Idaho drivers seeking an international driving permit must contact AAA because ITD does not issue that permit. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0003]
